channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: Functional Safety & SIL Explained
item.description: What a Safety Integrity Level really measures: PFDavg and PFH bands, SFF/HFT architectural constraints, voting, and a worked SIF example (IEC 61508/61511).

item.title: Gas Detector Types & Working Principles Explained
item.description: Catalytic bead, electrochemical, infrared, semiconductor and PID gas detectors compared — what each senses, how it works, and where it's applied.

item.title: Gas Insulated Substation (GIS) Explained
item.description: A GIS packs busbars, breakers, disconnects, earthing switches and transformers into a sealed, SF6-filled enclosure — key components, why it's used, and where.

item.title: Grade & Slope: Why Percent, Ratio and Degrees Aren't the Same Number
item.description: How rise over run converts between percent grade, a ratio like 1:20, and an angle in degrees — and why mixing up the three is a common site-drawing mistake.

item.title: Harmonics in Power Systems: Sources, Effects and How to Mitigate Them
item.description: Where harmonics come from, how IEEE 519 limits voltage THD at the point of common coupling, what unmanaged harmonics do to cables, transformers and capacitors.

item.title: Current THD and K-Factor: Why Harmonic Distortion Derates Your Transformer
item.description: How current THD and K-factor are calculated from a harmonic spectrum, why K-factor weights higher harmonics more heavily.

item.title: Heat Pump Sizing Basics: Why Electrification Made This a Core Skill
item.description: Why heat pump sizing isn't the same exercise as furnace or AC sizing, what COP and capacity-at-temperature actually mean.

item.title: HIRA vs. JSA vs. SOP: Which Safety Document Do You Actually Need?
item.description: HIRA, JSA and SOP operate at three different scopes and points in time — whole-workplace planning, one job before it starts, and the daily standard method.

item.title: How to Read a Full P&ID: A Complete Worked Walkthrough
item.description: A start-to-finish walkthrough of reading a P&ID — symbols, tag anatomy, valve types, and a fully worked example tracing one real control loop end to end.

item.title: How to Read a Wiring Diagram (Beginner's Guide)
item.description: What a wiring diagram actually shows, how it differs from a schematic and a single line diagram, the common symbols, and how wires get numbered — a beginner's walkthrough.

item.title: How to Select a Digital Protection Relay
item.description: A step-by-step working method for selecting a digital protection relay — from identifying the protected equipment through CT/VT matching, I/O sizing.

item.title: HVAC MEP Thumb Rules & Formulas: Quick Reference for Engineers
item.description: Preliminary-design thumb rules for cooling load, airflow, fan and pump power, chilled water flow, chiller capacity and pipe sizing — with the formula for each.

item.title: HVAC & Plumbing Default Design Values: The Quick Reference
item.description: Common default design values for HVAC and plumbing — duct/pipe velocities, pressure drops, ACH, noise criteria, fresh air rates and temperatures.

item.title: HVAC System Components Explained
item.description: How an HVAC system conditions a space, component by component — compressor, condenser, expansion device, evaporator, air handler, ductwork, and controls.

item.title: Icw, Icu, Ics & Icm Explained: Four kA Ratings, Four Different Jobs
item.description: Four short-circuit kA ratings on a breaker or busbar nameplate — Icw, Icu, Ics and Icm — what each one certifies, with a worked example showing how they relate.

item.title: IEC 104 Communication Protocol Explained
item.description: What IEC 60870-5-104 does, how it extends IEC 101 over TCP/IP, the master-slave request/response model, a security reference, and where it's used in SCADA.

item.title: IEC 61850 Digital Substation Protocol Explained
item.description: How IEC 61850 replaces hardwired substation panels with GOOSE, Sampled Values and MMS over Ethernet — the process/bay/station architecture, what each service actually carries, and the security tradeoffs.

item.title: IECEx / ATEX Zones vs NEC Class & Division: Hazardous Area Classification
item.description: How the IEC 60079/ATEX Zone system compares to the North American NEC Class & Division system — equivalency table, gas/dust groups, and Ex protection types.

item.title: Industrial Sensor Types Explained
item.description: What an industrial sensor actually does, the main types — inductive, capacitive, photoelectric, ultrasonic, RTD/thermocouple, pressure transmitter, level sensor, encoder — how to read a sensing-mode and output spec, and a selection guide.

item.title: Ingress Protection (IP) Ratings Explained
item.description: How an IP rating is built — the solid-protection digit, the liquid-protection digit, and optional letters — decoded against IEC 60529, with a NEMA cross-check.

item.title: IS, IEC & IEEE Codes: The Standards Behind Electrical Engineering
item.description: What IS, IEC and IEEE standards each actually govern, a working reference list across wiring, earthing, transformers, switchgear and solar PV.

item.title: Junction Boxes Explained: Types, Parts & Ratings
item.description: What a junction box does, the main types — pull box, gang box, weatherproof, explosion-proof, terminal box — its parts, ratings, box-fill sizing, and selection.

item.title: K-Rated Transformers: What K-Factor Means and When You Need One
item.description: What a K-rated transformer actually is, the IEEE C57.110 K-factor scale from K-1 to K-20, how it differs in construction from a standard transformer.

item.title: kW, kVA, and kVAR: What Actually Separates Them
item.description: Real power, apparent power, and reactive power explained through the power triangle.

item.title: Lighting Design by the Lumen Method: Why Luminaire Count Isn't Just Lumens ÷ Lux
item.description: Luminaire count for a target lux level using the lumen method, and why utilization and maintenance factors derate raw lumen output.

item.title: LMTD Heat Exchanger Sizing
item.description: Log-mean temperature difference explained — why it isn't just an average of the two ends, why counter-current beats co-current for the same terminal temperatures, and where the F correction factor comes in.

item.title: Load Estimation: The First Step in Electrical Design
item.description: Why load estimation comes before anything else in an electrical project, how to calculate it by floor area, NEC VA/m² guide tables.

item.title: Load Flow (Power Flow) Study Basics
item.description: What a load flow study actually calculates, the three bus types (slack, PV, PQ), why it comes before short-circuit and protection coordination studies, and how to read the results.

item.title: LV Panel Estimating: Why a Budgetary BOQ Starts With the Incomer, Not the Steel
item.description: How an LV panel's busbar size, enclosure dimensions and budgetary BOQ cost all cascade from just two inputs: the incomer rating and the number of outgoing ways.

item.title: IEC 61439 Forms of Construction: Form 1 to Form 4 Explained
item.description: What Form 1 through Form 4 switchboard construction actually separates inside an LV panel, the 2a/2b, 3a/3b and 4a/4b sub-variants.
